meaning:
we (first pers. pl.)
Aramaic of a.nach.nu (אֲנַ֫חְנוּ "we" H0587)

elsewhere.note: We inform the king that, if this city is built and the walls finished, then you will have no possession beyond the River.
Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered the king, “Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.
